title: [Feature Request] Additional values for local web server
symptom: The user wants access to more values on the local API, specifically glucose target values (like 80-180) and glucose prediction, and asks if it is already possible to get access to them. They note that the Nightscout endpoint may only return values if a running Nightscout is connected.
evidence_quote: I would like to be able to have access to more values on the local api. Would it be possible to integrate things like: - glucosetarget values like 80-180 _(the same I have used in xDrip of course)_ - glucoseprediction Or is it already possible to get access to it?
